# HPC Studio — Machine-Readable Documentation Index (`llms.txt`)

> HPC Studio is an integrated development environment (IDE) and sidecar supervisor architecture specifically engineered for high-performance computing (HPC), quantum materials simulation (Quantum ESPRESSO, AiiDA), interactive Jupyter notebooks with local/SSH execution, and agentic AI steering via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## Architecture & System Overview
- Two-Tier Decoupled Topology: Desktop Frontend (customized Code OSS workbench + native extension `hpc-studio`) paired with an autonomous local Sidecar Daemon (FastAPI / Uvicorn running on Python 3.12).
- IPC & Protocol Stack: Asynchronous HTTP/2 REST APIs and Server-Sent Events (SSE) on dynamic high-order loopback ports with strict HMAC-SHA256 bearer token authentication.
- Simulation & Computing Engines: Direct SSH/SFTP tunnels into Slurm workload managers, local/remote Jupyter ZeroMQ kernel engines, WebGL 3D crystallographic visualizer, and local/remote Quantum ESPRESSO engines.
- AI Agentic Layer: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing tools for cluster monitoring, job dispatch, crystallographic analysis, and simulation debugging directly to autonomous coding agents (Google Antigravity, Claude, Copilot).

---

## Primary Commands & Workflows

### Sidecar Daemon Management
- Start Sidecar: `uv run python -m hpc_studio.server --port 8000`
- Run Full Test Suite: `uv run pytest -v` (421 unit/integration tests)
- Type Check Frontend: `cd extensions/hpc-studio && npm run compile`

### MCP Integration (for AI Agents)
- Connect via stdio:
  ```json
  {
    "mcpServers": {
      "hpc-studio": {
        "command": "uv",
        "args": ["run", "python", "-m", "hpc_studio.mcp.server"],
        "cwd": "/home/nosedimetuxd/Proyectos/HPC Studio"
      }
    }
  }
  ```

### Key MCP Tools
- `hpc_list_clusters`: List registered HPC clusters and active connection states.
- `hpc_slurm_squeue`: Query remote Slurm queues with state filtering (R, PD, CG).
- `hpc_slurm_sbatch`: Submit job scripts to Slurm workload managers via SSH.
- `hpc_qe_validate_input`: Syntactically validate Quantum ESPRESSO `pw.x` input files.
- `hpc_qe_parse_output`: Parse total energy, SCF convergence, and forces from `pw.out`.
- `hpc_crystal_parse`: Load CIF/XYZ structures and compute fractional coordinates and spacegroups.
- `hpc_aiida_query_nodes`: Inspect provenance graphs and calculation nodes in AiiDA databases.

---

## Technical Baseline & Environment
- Runtime Environment: Linux (POSIX-compliant, GNOME/KDE/XFCE), Python 3.12, Node.js v20+, TypeScript 5.4.
- Core Dependencies: FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic v2, Paramiko, PyZMQ, ASE, SeeK-path, Three.js / WebGL.
- Test Coverage: 421/421 passing tests (100% test success rate).
